title: Mastery Below the Surface: EOD Underwater Training
description: U.S. Marines with 7th Engineer Support Battalion, 1st Marine Logistics Group, conduct an underwater maritime explosive ordnance disposal exercise on Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, Feb. 9, 2026. This training is essential toward maritime EOD operations, presenting unique explosive threats, and further enhancing the capabilities of EOD technicians being able to operate effectively and safely in more challenging domains. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Alan Gomez)
location_text: MARINE CORPS BASE CAMP PENDLETON, CALIFORNIA, US
